statement:
I'll look up the provenance record for lot L-4410 and then proceed with publishing.
The record shows this is elephant ivory carved in 2014 and imported from Cameroon in 2015, which violates U.S. law prohibiting commercial trade in African elephant ivory with very limited exceptions (generally only antiques pre-dating 1976).
